questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: We had to be present at the University really ahead and could not register the courses online without first coming to University. I had a job that I had to quit so I could not have come earlier. Afterwards it was really hard getting into the subjects that I wanted.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Some, they told me to email the professors. Some professors didn't even replied.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Thankfully I got into all the classes that I wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Really be prepared with the subjects that you want to take. Prepare and count ECT in advance so you can just put it into the computers once you can
